item.title: Jamaat warns against ‘farcical’ election
item.description: Jamaat-e-Islami on Thursday alleged that voters are being deceived through the distribution of so-called "dummy cards," including family, health, and agriculture cards, similar to past incidents involving rice distribution at Tk 10. item.title: Saudi, Qatar, Oman convinced Trump to stop Iran attack
item.description: RIYADH, Jan 15: Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Oman led efforts to talk US President Donald Trump out of an attack on Iran, fearing "grave blowbacks in the region", a senior Saudi official told AFP on Thursday.The Gulf trio "led a long, frantic, diplomatic last-minute effort to convince President Trump to give Iran a chance to show good intention", the official said on condition of anonymity, adding that dialogue was continuing.Some personnel were moved out of a major US military base in Qatar on Wedne

item.title: Interim govt held hostage by small radical faction: Debapriya

item.title: Cricketers agree to conditional return today

item.title: Pabna-1, 2 polls to be held on Feb 12

item.title: BNP opposes irregularities in postal ballot for expatriate voters

item.title: BCB removes Najmul from Finance Committee
item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Thursday initiated formal disciplinary proceedings against one of its Board members over what it described as "objectionable comments", while also removing the official from his position as Chairman of the Finance Committee in a move aimed at safeguarding the organisation's stability.In a statement, the BCB expressed regret over the remarks made by the Board member Najmul Islam acknowledging the concern and criticism generated within the cricketing community

item.title: Fresh election schedule declared for Pabna-1, Pabna-2

item.title: 3 killed in Uttara building fire
item.description: Three individuals were killed in a fire that broke out in a residential building in the capital’s Uttara on Friday morning.The identities of the deceased are yet to be known.The incident occurred on the second floor of a seven-storey building on Road 18 in Sector 11.Fire Service and Civil Defence media cell acting officer Talha Bin Jasim said they received information about the fire at 7:50 AM.
